title: Decision: .cargo/config.toml musl linker configuration
description: .cargo/config.toml explicitly names the musl linkers (x86_64-linux-musl-gcc, aarch64-linux-musl-gcc) for their respective targets. Prevents mysterious link failures when cross-compiling to musl, and documents the exact toolchain required. This is deployment-critical since the target is a static musl binary.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — rationale note affirming .cargo/config.toml musl linker config is correct. Not a finding. No action needed.
